name: What should Denver-area homeowners think about when coordinating kitchen appliance placement in a smaller home?

mainEntity.name: What should Denver-area homeowners think about when coordinating kitchen appliance placement in a smaller home?

acceptedAnswer.text: The biggest local issue in Denver-area homes is often **space efficiency**. In tighter kitchens, galley, L-shaped, and one-wall layouts need careful appliance placement so doors do not block aisles and the main work zones still have enough room to function.
acceptedAnswer.description: In Denver-area kitchens, space planning matters a lot. Smaller layouts need careful appliance placement so walkways stay open and the main cooking, cleaning, and prep zones still work well.
